versions.title: Looks + Character: Variation, Flicker, Dissolve, Fringe
versions.where: Color page > Effects > OpenFX > Light Trails
notes: Looks menu: Analog Horror, Sodium Haze, Neon Rain, Dream, Subtle (sets the controls; everything stays editable).
Character group: Variation, Flicker (+speed), Dissolve (+ember size), Fringe.
All new controls default to off: renders exactly like 2.3. All on adds about 3-11% at Medium.

versions.title: Trail colour: Color and Tail Color
versions.where: Color page > Effects > OpenFX > Light Trails
notes: New Color and Tail Color pickers (Look group): the trail blends from Color at the light to Tail Color at its smoky end.
Default white renders exactly like 2.2.
Everything else as 2.2 (no centre seam, soft tails, Blend Softness).

versions.title: No centre seam, soft tails, Blend Softness
versions.where: Color page > Effects > OpenFX > Light Trails
notes: Fixes the hard vertical line down the middle of frame: Inward/Outward now decide by which side the light is on, with a soft crossfade, so trails cross the centre.
Trails fade out over their last third instead of stopping dead.
New Blend Softness slider: 0 straight add; higher rolls trail highlights off and sinks them into bright areas like screen. Instant to change.
GPU status line removed from the controls (still in the log).

versions.title: Static-light streaks (Inward), crash fixes
versions.where: Color page > Effects > OpenFX > Light Trails
notes: Direction: Inward (default), Outward, Up, Angle trail from still lamps using only the current frame. Follow Motion keeps the old behavior.
Fixes the brighter-highlights-but-no-trails result on locked-off shots.
Likely fix for the Decay crash: never fetches a frame it did not declare; the frame cache tolerates grain; Resolve's GPU buffers are size-checked; every render is logged first.
Length is now % of frame width; Rise and Angle added; Drift removed.
Known problem: Inward/Outward cut trails with a hard vertical line at the centre of frame (fixed in 2.2).

versions.title: Quality menu, depth band, GPU only
versions.where: Color page > Effects > OpenFX > Light Trails
notes: Quality Low / Medium / High / Final, whites-only key, depth band, GPU frame cache, Resolve CUDA buffers.
Known problems: trails only from moving lights (still lamps just get brighter); could fetch undeclared frames after a cache reset (suspected crash).

versions.title: First CUDA build, CPU fallback
versions.where: Color page > Effects > OpenFX > Light Trails
notes: All trail math on the GPU with automatic CPU fallback; Use GPU switch in the Device group.
Untick Use GPU to get 1.0's CPU-only behavior.
Known problems: very slow in Resolve (every render re-fetches 12 frames through CPU memory); trails only from moving lights.

versions.title: Fusion Fuse (first version) + original DCTL
notes: Lua Fuse with DCTL compute kernels; Fusion page only.
The zip also keeps the original single-frame LightTrails.dctl and preview.py from the first project.
